page.overview:
What is Murder One?

Murder One is the eleventh track from Metallica's tenth studio album Hardwired...to Self-Destruct. It was written by James Hetfield and Lars Ulrich.

The song is a touching and heartfelt tribute to Lemmy Kilmister, the lead singer of Motörhead who has passed away. The song is named after Lemmy's well-known Marshall amplifier, and its lyrics include titles of Motörhead songs while also highlighting Lemmy's legendary influence on Metallica. This track is featured on the album Hardwired...to Self-Destruct.

One crown Shines on through the sound One crown Born to lose One man Does not give a damn One man No excuse

Aces wild Aces high All the aces Aces ‘til you die
